intro: Vrang asks you to check his traps across a valley in the Barrens. The small game they catch will help him, while other wildlife can make the area dangerous.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: While you are out there, it would be of great help to me if you could check on my traps for me. I've got them strewn all over the valley.
Bring back any small game that I've caught. Keep your eye out for the other wildlife, though. This area can be dangerous if you aren't paying attention.
